verdict.rationale: dlt is itself a Python framework for writing custom sources. The declarative REST API source lets you configure endpoints, relationships, pagination and authentication for any REST API, and dlt-init-openapi generates pipeline code from an OpenAPI 3.x spec. Community reports corroborate that users build many long-tail sources this way ("around a thousand new data sources each month"), and that it is easier than Singer taps. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of building a connector for a non-OpenAPI long-tail API with unusual auth or pagination, and any visual/no-code builder beyond declarative Python config.
